question: Contá los ensayos de melanoma que incluyen nivolumab entre sus intervenciones.

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions bc WHERE bc.nct_id = s.nct_id AND bc.downcase_mesh_term = 'melanoma')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND i.name ILIKE '%nivolumab%')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND o.name ILIKE '%nivolumab%'))
